headline: Malware Incident Halts Production at G-TEKT's Thailand Facilities
body: A malware incident has led to the shutdown of production lines at G-TEKT's Thailand operations, according to company officials. The breach impacted factory networks, forcing a halt in several critical manufacturing processes. The company has begun system restoration efforts and plans a phased reopening of affected areas. As of now, there are no reports of ransom demands linked to the attack.
